user.title: Govee BLE Executor
user.description: Executes Bluetooth operations on behalf of the govee2mqtt add-on. The defaults are deliberately conservative: one connection at a time keeps the add-on from competing with your other Bluetooth devices for proxy connection slots.

data_description.max_concurrent: How many devices may be talked to at once. Raise this only if commands feel sluggish and your proxies have slots to spare.
data_description.idle_timeout: How long a connection is kept open after the last command, so that a burst of commands reuses it.
